shared_or_similar_visual_information: Multiple filled pieces separated by unfilled parts of the surrounding figure. On the left, use the four light-blue sectors at the corners of the square. On the right, use the gray patches at the upper-left and lower-right corners of the rectangle.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The coloring selects the four quarter disks while excluding the white center. Right image: The fill selects two corner regions separated by unshaded parts of the rectangle.
Rationales: In each figure the fill specifies the components included in a total area. The unfilled pieces do not contribute to that total.
